request.description: Registers the Expo push token of this app session (`null` removes it). A token moves to the newest session that registers it, so a re-installed app does not get the same push twice. When a user has a push token, transactional messages (new lead, follow-up due and similar) go by push instead of SMS; email is unchanged. Realtime updates for open screens use the WebSocket namespace `/v1/realtime` (Socket.IO, send the access token as `auth.token`; rooms per user, session, membership, organization and staff; events carry ids only, refetch the resource). Any signed-in context.
